title: Define the YMP product intent, vocabulary, and architecture
goal: Establish the product purpose, governing principles, canonical domain language, and subsystem boundaries before implementation expands.
scope: Define the intended outcomes and explicit product boundaries.
Name the domain concepts and trusted responsibilities used by later work.
Describe dependency and authority boundaries without claiming planned capabilities exist.
acceptance: The intent, domain vocabulary, architecture, and roadmap are present and mutually consistent.
Planned capabilities are clearly distinguished from implemented behavior.
The repository development contract points contributors to the governing documents.
context: This record describes documentation delivered before the executable foundation.

history.note: Recorded the delivered product definition from commit b4b5ec7.
